plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Culinary Arts map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The program has TWO pathways; this plan transcribes the first/default 'to CSU' (CSU Bakersfield) pathway in full. The second pathway, 'to Degree' (60-72.5 units, 4 terms), is a second GE pattern for the same credential, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 64-78.5 units, and term totals as 17-18.5 / 15 / 15 / 17-30. Ranged slots: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 4 'CULN B48WE Work Experience Education' (1-14, a fixed major course printed at a variable 1-14 units). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged slot is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 64 units. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites' flag (the word does not appear on the map page), so no prereqs are recorded. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
